scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run generate-icon && vite build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.build:dir: npm run typecheck && npm run generate-icon && vite build && electron-builder --win --dir --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.build:nsis: npm run typecheck && npm run generate-icon && vite build && electron-builder --win nsis --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.release: npm run typecheck && npm run generate-icon && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File build-release.ps1
scripts.release:minor: npm run typecheck && npm run generate-icon && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File build-release.ps1 minor
scripts.release:major: npm run typecheck && npm run generate-icon && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File build-release.ps1 major
